issues.title: No DAW projects indexed yet
issues.description: The session catalog is empty. Run daw-project-scan to discover and index all DAW project files in the sessions directory.
issues.resolution: Run 'navig skill run daw-project-scan --path sessions/' to populate the catalog.

issues.title: Sample library not cataloged
issues.description: The sample catalog is empty. Samples directory needs to be scanned and indexed with BPM, key, and type tags.
issues.resolution: Run 'navig skill run sample-catalog --path samples/' to build the index.

issues.title: Loudness standard not configured
issues.description: Default loudness standard is set to 'streaming' (-14 LUFS). Confirm this matches your primary distribution target.
issues.resolution: Edit .navig/config.yaml and set loudness_standard to streaming, broadcast, or club.
